key_findings: One week after SNI, KCC2 transcript in layer 5 pyramidal cells of prelimbic and infralimbic mPFC was strongly increased and the NKCC1/KCC2 ratio decreased, but not in the ACC.

GABAA reversal potential in mPFC L5 pyramidal neurons became hypernegative in SNI mice (-71.4 vs -62.3 mV), and network modeling showed this reduces cortical output, a proposed mechanism of mPFC deactivation in neuropathic pain.
